image_description: A dark blue and white minibus parked on a gravel surface. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a large front windshield, side windows, and visible branding/text on the side and front. A portion of another blue vehicle is visible in the bottom right foreground. The image appears to be a photograph or a high-fidelity generation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic compact, boxy silhouette of a minibus, distinct from larger transit buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, and multiple side windows are present along the passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. The driver's door is visible, and the sliding passenger door track/handle area is implied on the side.
The seam and handle structure for a sliding side door are visible behind the front wheel arch.
The short hood and grille arrangement indicate a front-engine layout typical of this class of van/minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame; only the front three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a two-tone blue and white livery with visible text/logos, fitting the description of company livery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportional to the vehicle body and appears to be a standard steel rim with a hubcap.
The window configuration and overall size are consistent with a vehicle designed for 4-10 passengers.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side door ('go...') and the license plate/front badge appears distorted and illegible, a common artifact in AI-generated images where text rendering fails to produce coherent characters.
The geometry around the front wheel arch is slightly warped; the fender line does not align perfectly with the door seam, and the tire contact patch looks slightly soft/unrealistic.
The blue object in the bottom right corner (possibly another car) has ambiguous geometry and blends oddly with the ground, suggesting minor perspective or segmentation issues.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific make/model classification and ensure it falls within the 'minibus' taxonomy rather than a standard van or full-size bus.
To rigorously analyze the garbled text on the side and front, determining if it is nonsensical gibberish (artifact) or just low-resolution real text.
To check for boundary bleeding between the tire and fender, and to verify the continuity of the door seams which appeared slightly warped.
To assess global coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle texture anomalies in the paint or glass reflections.

focus_areas: Text legibility on side and front
Wheel well geometry and tire grounding
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifacts. If the text is completely nonsensical, it is a strong indicator of AI generation despite the photorealistic style. Also, scrutinize the front wheel arch for 'melting' or asymmetry compared to the rest of the body lines.
